name: sdlc-worktree-isolation
description: PreToolUse Bash gate that blocks mutating git operations against designated shared primary checkouts. Allows read-only git operations, non-designated repos, and linked per-session worktrees of the shared repo. Prevents concurrent sessions from colliding through one HEAD/index in a shared brain/infra checkout.

output.target: resolved target git toplevel or working directory

known_limitations: git --git-dir=/--work-tree= redirection and deeply obfuscated invocations may bypass target resolution; XOS-44 removes the shared primary checkout and supersedes deep hardening of this interim gate.
litmus: Before any mutating git operation against a configured shared repo: is the target the shared primary checkout, or a per-session linked worktree? If primary — BLOCK and instruct the agent to use git worktree add; if linked worktree, read-only operation, or non-designated repo — PASS.
origin: XOS-43, 2026-06-09 — two concurrent sessions both ran mutating git operations against the same primary checkout, causing bilateral data loss and an index.lock race. sdlc-work-claim coordinates tickets; this rule coordinates filesystem isolation.
